summary: Author of the appreciation article and colleague of von Karman.

name: Maurice von Karman

aliases: Commanding General of the Army Air Forces
name: H. H. Arnold

name: Royal Aeronautical Society
summary: Society of which von Karman was a devoted member.

name: Budapest Royal Technical University
summary: University where von Karman graduated as a mechanical engineer.

name: University of Gottingen
summary: University where von Karman earned his Ph.D. and served as Privatdozent.

name: University of Aachen
summary: University where von Karman was Professor of Aeronautics and Mechanics.

summary: Institute directed by von Karman.

name: Austro-Hungarian Aviation Corps

summary: Laboratory directed by von Karman.
